jurisdiction.venue: U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts & SEC

headline: Thirty Charged in Decade-Long Scheme to Monetize Confidential BigLaw Merger Files
deck: Prosecutors and the S.E.C. say 30 defendants leaked law-firm deal rooms to trade ahead of $140 billion in corporate mergers.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: 30 defendants charged across criminal and SEC dockets; 19 arrested, 2 abroad, 1 guilty plea entered.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Snatching $1,800 worth of electronics from a storefront display
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Felony grand larceny arraignment within 24 hours; no multi-year trading window
